Welcome to SRC Land Building & Real Estate

Your trusted partner in Texas real estate, construction, and property development.

At SRC Land Building & Real Estate, we transform ideas into landmarks that stand the test of time. With over 15 years of proven experience in the Texas real estate market, we proudly deliver innovative construction, development, and investment solutions across residential, commercial, and mixed-use properties.

From land acquisition to final handover, our team brings together expert craftsmanship, transparency, and strategic insight to help clients achieve success in every stage of their real estate journey. We collaborate with homebuyers, investors, franchise owners, developers, tenants, and business leaders — offering a complete suite of services that make property ownership and investment seamless and rewarding.

Each project we undertake is built on a foundation of innovation, sustainability, and trust, ensuring every client receives results that exceed expectations. From custom developments to real estate investment consulting, we combine vision and precision to create spaces that inspire growth and community.

Discover the difference with SRC Land Building & Real Estate — where your Texas property dreams take shape with expertise, honesty, and excellence.

Welcome to SRC Land Building & Real Estate

Your premier destination for Real Estate solutions that transcend the ordinary. With over 15 years of experience in the Texas real estate market, SRC Land Building & Real Estate is your trusted partner for delivering innovative construction and real estate solutions. We take pride in passionately serving diverse clients, including investors, buyers, franchisees, developers, tenants, and business leaders, delivering quality, value, and transparency at every stage of their property journey.

LEADERS

We are your trusted gateway to premium real estate. Here’s what we offer:

Land and Real Estate

Design & Planning

Land and Real Estate

Our experienced real estate planners offer comprehensive demographic analysis, site due diligence, and land acquisition or sale services to guide you through every stage of land development and property investment. Whether you’re identifying a prime location, assessing land potential, or finalizing a purchase, we ensure every decision is backed by accurate data, expert insight, and market-driven strategy — helping you make confident and profitable real estate moves across Texas and beyond.

Design & Planning

Our skilled designers and architects specialize in creating innovative, functional, and visually striking plans using Revit and AutoCAD software. From conceptual layouts to detailed final blueprints, we provide end-to-end architectural design services tailored to your project’s unique goals. Whether it’s a residential build, commercial development, or custom franchise project, our team ensures every design reflects precision, efficiency, and creativity — delivering solutions that align with Texas construction standards and your long-term vision.

Real Estate Agency

Our expert real estate agents connect investors, buyers, and sellers with the most profitable and high-potential properties across Texas. From property discovery to closing, we handle every step with dedicated market research, transparent communication, and strategic negotiation. Our success-based, competitive fee structure ensures you get maximum value with measurable results — making real estate transactions seamless, secure, and rewarding. Whether you’re investing in commercial properties, buying residential land, or selling development-ready lots, SRC Land Building & Real Estate is your trusted partner for smart property investments in Texas.

Permitting

Our experienced planners and permitting specialists collaborate closely with city, county, state, and federal agencies to ensure smooth coordination and compliance throughout every phase of your project. From zoning and engineering approvals to site planning and city permitting, we manage all the essential details that move your development forward efficiently. With our deep understanding of Texas regulations and municipal processes, SRC Land Building & Real Estate helps you navigate complex approval requirements with confidence — saving time, reducing costs, and ensuring your project progresses without delays.

Construction

Our dedicated Construction Team oversees every aspect of your project — from engineering coordination and bank approvals to sub-contractor management and on-site supervision — ensuring a seamless build process from start to finish. We maintain strict quality control and open communication at every stage, guaranteeing that your project meets all Texas building codes and safety standards. From breaking ground to the final Certificate of Occupancy, SRC Land Building & Real Estate delivers timely, compliant, and high-quality construction outcomes that stand as a true reflection of our commitment to excellence and integrity.

Property Tax Protest

Our experienced Legal and Real Estate team brings deep knowledge of the Texas property market to help clients navigate the complexities of real estate law, title verification, and tax negotiations with confidence. We provide strategic guidance on property transactions, zoning compliance, and investment structuring, ensuring every deal is both legally sound and financially optimized. With a results-driven approach and a clear understanding of state and local tax frameworks, SRC Land Building & Real Estate helps you maximize returns, minimize risks, and secure long-term value in every real estate investment.

About Us

Who We Are

SPECIALISTS

Our unwavering commitment lies with our clients and the industry we serve. We are dedicated to providing nothing short of excellence, going the extra mile to understand and fulfill the unique needs of each client. Our foundation is built upon fostering long-term relationships based on trust, transparency, and open communication. We continuously stay abreast of the latest industry advancements and trends, enabling us to deliver innovative solutions that surpass client expectations. Our tireless pursuit of improvement and unwavering focus on customer satisfaction distinguish us as a dependable and respected partner in the industry. With SRC, you can expect nothing less than our utmost dedication to your success.

About Us

Who We Are

CAPABILITIES

Our unwavering commitment lies with our clients and the industry we serve. We are dedicated to providing nothing short of excellence, going the extra mile to understand and fulfill the unique needs of each client. Our foundation is built upon fostering long-term relationships based on trust, transparency, and open communication. We continuously stay abreast of the latest industry advancements and trends, enabling us to deliver innovative solutions that surpass client expectations. Our tireless pursuit of improvement and unwavering focus on customer satisfaction distinguish us as a dependable and respected partner in the industry. With SRC, you can expect nothing less than our utmost dedication to your success.

Our Mission

At SRC, our work starts long before construction begins.

We begin with a conversation to understand your vision, needs, and goals. From there, we take care of everything: finding the right land, navigating approvals, designing the space, and building it down to the last detail.

We’ve built retail centers, office buildings, and custom developments across Texas—but we’re really proud of the trust our clients place in us. Whether you’re a business owner expanding your footprint or an investor bringing a new vision to life, we’re here to make the entire process smoother, brighter, and more personal.

Our Core Values

Quality That Speaks for Itself
We never cut corners. Whether it’s the materials we choose or the teams we work with, we hold everything to a higher standard—because the spaces we build should stand the test of time.

Absolute Value, Every Step of the Way
Construction is a significant decision. We get that. That’s why we focus on giving you more of what you pay for—more insight, guidance, and long-term value in your investment.

Honesty in Every Interaction
We don’t sugarcoat timelines, budgets, or setbacks. We tell you what you need to know, when you need to know it, because trust is built on transparency, which matters to us more than anything else.

Count on Us
If we say we’ll do it, we’ll do it—on time and without excuses. Our clients count on us to keep projects moving forward, and we take that responsibility seriously.

Smart, Efficient, and Cost-Conscious
We believe great work doesn’t have to come with a sky-high price tag. We’re careful with your budget, as if it’s our own, delivering high-quality and cost-effective solutions.

Why choose us?

At SRC, our ethos transcends mere transactions; we prioritize cultivating enduring relationships with our clients, founded on trust and mutual respect. Our team of seasoned experts is driven by a commitment to delivering unparalleled excellence, drawing upon years of experience and a comprehensive understanding of the Real Estate, Design, and construction sectors to guarantee your success.

We understand that each project is unique, and we approach every endeavor with a personalized touch, tailored to meet our clients’ distinct needs and aspirations. By fostering open communication, collaboration, and transparency throughout the process, we aim to meet and exceed expectations, forging partnerships built to withstand the test of time.

At SRC, our dedication to client satisfaction is unwavering. We stand ready to accompany you on your journey towards achieving your goals in real estate, design, and construction.

Protest Services

Land & Real Estate

SRC offers a full spectrum of land services—acquisition, development, and sales—with deep expertise that goes beyond typical brokerage. SRC’s planners guide you through easement and title reviews, traffic analysis, contract negotiations, and more. Whether buying or selling land, buildings, or operating businesses, we leverage Texas market insights and demographic data to help you make confident decisions.

Land & Real Estate

SRC offers various land locations, land development and land acquisition services. In most cases, we acquire land, develop it and sell it to clients. This experience allows us to be your confidants in land purchase decisions above and beyond what a real estate broker can offer. For example, easement reviews, title reviews and title research, city and county research, paralegal reviews, traffic analysis, and contract term negotiations are some of the activities that can make a difference but you don’t necessarily have the time and energy to do it all.

SRC has in-house brokers who assist on the buy and sell side of real estate transactions whether you are buying or selling land, building or want to buy an existing running business. They have significant knowledge of the Texas real estate growth trends as well as access to the deep knowledge base of our demographics research.

Real Estate Agency

We help investors find and buy land, retail, and daycare properties by managing thorough research and offer negotiations with multiple agents. SRC’s real estate team applies success-based, competitive fees that apply only upon closing. Sellers benefit from our specialized marketing and sales expertise in daycare buildings, retail strips, and land parcels across Texas.

Real Estate Agency

We help investors find and buy land, retail, and daycare properties by managing thorough research and offer negotiations with multiple agents. SRC’s real estate team applies success-based, competitive fees that apply only upon closing. Sellers benefit from our specialized marketing and sales expertise in daycare buildings, retail strips, and land parcels across Texas.
